npc:10378.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?
Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $n.

npc:10668.text: The body is that of a female orc warrior.$B$BIt is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased orc--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.$B$BBased on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.$B$BHe will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

npc:10881.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

npc:11066.text: To die in battle is glorious! But, with what I teach you, maybe you not die so quickly, hm?

npc:11860.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

npc:11861.text: Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.$B$B$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

npc:12616.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:16227.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:233.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

npc:2388.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

npc:2389.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:253092.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

npc:266881.text: What business do you have in the Echo Isles, $c?

npc:2855.text: We use many animal pelts and skins in our creations.

npc:3033.text: Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.$B$BIt never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

npc:3143.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

npc:3154.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

npc:3171.text: I train and guide young hunters in the traditions passed down many generations.

npc:3191.text: I can teach you how to cook!
Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

npc:3230.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

npc:3296.text: Go to Kodohide Leatherworkers in The Drag. Ask for Kamari.

npc:3318.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

npc:3345.text: You may have what it takes. Let's find out!
Your skills are out of my league, stranger.Talk to Hgarth at the Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He will provide you with more knowledge than I can.

npc:3363.text: I made a lot of the things you see in the store. What do you think? Answer carefully, your life may depend on it.

npc:3365.text: The twists and turns of Orgrimmar are designed to thwart invaders. Can you imagine how quickly one of those puny gnomes would get lost in here? Ha! If it was lucky, I'd track it down and keep it as a pet.
You can't study my techniques until you've learned the basics. Speak with Kamari if you are interested in training.

npc:3387.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

npc:3389.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

npc:3430.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, skyborne.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

You! $R! Come here. <snort>$B$BTime is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>$B$BMy capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!$B$BThe Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

npc:3432.text: I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.$B$BHe claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

npc:3433.text: The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.$B$BHe feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

npc:3615.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

npc:4312.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:4551.text: How may I be of service?

npc:4568.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.

npc:5811.text: Too bad we can't skin the humans and their allies. All that skin is just going to waste. Still, who'd want to wear the flimsy leather you could make out of it?
I have nothing more to teach you. Talk to Karolek if you wish to further your leatherworking skills.
You like the rug? I killed and skinned the beast myself. May all the centaur fall as easily.

npc:5953.text: You'll need to head to Orgrimmar for that.  Just follow the road heading out of Razor Hill to the north through the canyon and you'll come to it.  When you get there ask one of their grunts for further directions.

npc:6491.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

npc:6740.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

npc:6746.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

npc:6928.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

npc:7714.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

npc:7953.text: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

npc:8931.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

npc:2215.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

npc:2216.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

npc:234.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

npc:3139.text: Throm'ka, $c. There is little time for talk and much work to be done.

npc:3142.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

npc:3188.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

npc:3194.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

npc:3304.text: The sands of Durotar are tough and dry compared to the tropical and lush lands we're from, but we Darkspear persevere. Where chief Vol'jin leads, we will follow.

npc:3446.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the skyborne I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

meta.attribution: Data from Efficient Games (https://efficient.games), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

complete.text: Good work, friend.  You have earned your pay well.  Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.

accept.text: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.

objectives.text: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.

progress.text: Woof?

complete.text: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad.  The battle goes well.
Mission accomplished, $c.  And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.

progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?

accept.text: Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!$B$BThe Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!

objectives.text: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

accept.text: $n, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.$B$BI want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?$B$BYou can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.

objectives.text: Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in Thunder Bluff.

complete.text: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.

The Horde would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack. But by preventing such an attack, we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.

And as sure as there is sand in the Tanaris desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.

You have served your people well, $c.

Hmmm, not bad, $N. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.

Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.

There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.

I have no more to teach you, $N. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.

progress.text: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined warrior will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.

complete.text:
Most excellent, $N. Any good $c will surely find a use for this bag on the battlefield.

I salute your vigor and willingness to die in the name of the Horde!

progress.text:
I fought proudly alongside the Warchief when these lands were pioneered. The scars of battle mark my skin.

The honor of the Horde has been upheld with the help of my axe and battlecry during the defeat of Archimonde, when the unholy alliance was made with the humans and elves, wrought from necessity.

But my position as watchman and provider has given me a new sense of worth.

complete.text:
You have done well, $N.

Although the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.

You retrieved it!  Well done!

Your efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials.  But I fear they have further aims in our land.

We have not seen the end of them.

progress.text: Is your task complete, $N?  Do you have the Burning Blade Medallion?

complete.text:
From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.

However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, $N. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.

accept.text: Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley.  But I want you to report your findings.$B$BGo to the troll village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin.  Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.$B$BTell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials.  Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.$B$BGo, $n, and be swift.  I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...

objectives.text: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

complete.text: Thank you, $N.  You have saved Minshina.  You have saved my brother's spirit from slavery!

progress.text: Do you have my brother's skull, $N?  Is he finally free?

complete.text:
You might be weak, but at least you're not clumsy, $N.

Here, take this and get outta my way. I've got cooking to do.

progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!

accept.text: $n, please, can you help me? My son Kron went hunting days ago, and he still hasn't returned. He went west towards the Barrens to hunt crocolisks along Southfury River. I fear the worst.$B$BAs strong as he was, his stubborn pride has always drawn him into trouble. I warned him that the crocolisks were powerful and vicious. He grew angry and stormed off.$B$BIf you can't find him, at least bring me a sign of his fate... even if you have to open up the stomach of every crocolisk along the Southfury's banks.

objectives.text: Bring a sign of Kron's fate to Misha Tor'kren at the farmstead northwest of Razor Hill.

progress.text:
I remember my first tiger hunt, $N. I chose to hunt on the largest of the Echo Isles, and I sat perfectly still in the shadows of its foliage for almost a full day... watching... waiting.

My muscles were taut, and I was ready to strike. It was one of my greatest victories when that tiger finally took the bait.
Time is the true test of your strength and will. Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.

complete.text:
Haha... I never thought I'd make more of this stuff ever again.

You've stirred in me a great sense of nostalgia, $N. Kind of reminds me of the last time I made a batch of trogg brew. Thank you. The memories warm my stomach.

progress.text: How's the search going?

accept.text: Good stuff, that stormstout, huh?$B$BI have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.$B$BBring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.$B$BLike I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.

objectives.text: Bring 5 Lightning Glands, 1 Thunderhawk Saliva Gland and 1 Kodo Liver to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet.

complete.text: Yes?  You have something to report?  Well then, let's have it!

Your recovery mission was a success, $c. I will see to it that these tools get to Orgrimmar with the next caravan.

Nicely done.

progress.text:
Once we learn how the humans operate their strange machinery, we will stand a greater chance of defeating them in future battles.

With our new gained knowledge, the Horde only stands to grow in strength.

complete.text:
With Zalazane gone, our tribe can again sleep in peace.

Thank you, $N.  The Darkspear tribe owes you much.  If you suffer from an ailment, visit my assistant Bom'bay, behind me.  His voodoo is strong...

progress.text: Is Zalazane defeated, $N?

complete.text: This does not bode well at all. You were wise to bring this information to my attention.

progress.text: There is a look of concern on your face, $c. What have you there?
Can you not see that I am busy? This had better be pressing....

accept.text: A $c like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.$b$bTell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.$b$bSeems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.$b$bYou can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!

objectives.text: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.

complete.text:
You please me, $N. The eggs and the tool. Well done.

And for your reward...

progress.text: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.

accept.text: You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.$B$BIf you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.

complete.text:
Yes, yes... filled with joy because finally <snort> the Bristleback know my tribe's pain, skyborne. That is how I should feel, but that <snort> is not the case.

You aid your people and they honor you. Mangletooth aids his people, and what do they do? They turn their backs on him. They forget him and leave him to rot in cage!

I aid them even from locked behind bars and they send no one to save me!

objectives.text: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

accept.text:
Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, skyborne. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>

Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, skyborne, like they have killed me.

objectives.text: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

complete.text: Good. Go with Agamaggan's spirit as your guide, skyborne. Return to me if you desire more of Agamaggan's magics.

progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.

accept.text: The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.$B$BIf you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!

objectives.text: Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

complete.text:
$C, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.

Although my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.

progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.

accept.text: You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.$b$bWould that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.$b$bI have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.

complete.text:
Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.

What a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!

objectives.text: Kill 4 Sons of Cenarius, 4 Daughters of Cenarius and 4 Cenarion Botanists for Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.

accept.text: They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!$b$bMagic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.$b$bBring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.

objectives.text: Bring Ordanus' head to Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.

accept.text: $n, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.$B$BIf you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.

complete.text:
So, $N, you have come.  Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young $c, then listen on...

objectives.text: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.$B$BBut the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.$B$BThe hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.$B$BFind Steelsnap, $n.  Find him, and defeat him.

objectives.text: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: The troll mage Deino has need of your assistance, $n.  She resides in Orgrimmar, in the Darkbriar Lodge.

objectives.text: Speak with Deino.

complete.text:
Ah, this is the food Ukor brought to the Valley of Trials.  Did they not need it?  Well, I guess they like to starve you heroes in training.  Builds spirit, they say!

Thank you for returning the food.  I'll stick it back on the shelves... but here, let me offer you some refreshment first!

And don't forget to rest here in the inn.  You may be a brave $c ready to take on the world, but if your energy is sapped you won't be doing yourself, or the Horde, much good.

progress.text: Welcome to Razor Hill!

complete.text:
Now we teach them those things, and they teach us others. We become one race... almost. We be allies for long time now. So you remember to help them. And Jen'shan remember to help you.

Jen'shan teach you da ways of the $c--teach you good. You never forget, $c's be respected greatly by da tribe. You be havin' a large role to play in da future... you never forget that.

When you feel da need, come to Jen'shan. She teach you as much as she can when she feel you ready.

progress.text:
Jen'shan see a mighty $c before her and da spirits approve.

Da path of da $c is one of our oldest walks of life. Da Horde turned to us when they be just strugglin' to survive on Azeroth, and they ask us to teach them, to show them the secrets of many tings. They were strong already: strong in shaman ways; strong in warrior ways. But the $c path not be their path... then.

complete.text: Well now... Where did you find this?

progress.text: Whaddya got?

accept.text: This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.$B$BShe'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. The Horde will not tolerate her outrunners here.$B$B$n, travel to the Talon Den. Kill Rynthariel, and then put up a symbol for all to see. Take this Horde flag, $n. Put it up in the Talon Den so that they will not be so rash as to send another messenger through our territory again.

objectives.text: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.

complete.text:
"BACAW!!!"

The chicken starts to gobble up the feed you put down.

After a moment, the chicken looks around, startled. It uncomfortably shuffles back and forth. Is this chicken pregnant? You think you better check underneath it.

progress.text:
The chicken stares at you with dark, cold eyes. It waits for you hungrily.

"BACAAAW!

Cluck...cluck...cluck."

complete.text:
You have done it!  You have defeated the Kolkar!

I will be sure Thrall receives word of your actions here, $N.

Stand tall.  You do yourself, and the Horde, proud.

progress.text: Do you have the banner?

complete.text: Wonderful, $N! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.

progress.text: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?

complete.text:
Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?

A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.
I understand. Thank you, $c.

progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, skyborne.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!

Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>

All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.

accept.text: Along with the thorns, the blood affected <snort> other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems <snort> for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. <snort>$B$BI know the secrets of that magic.$B$BBring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! <snort>

complete.text:
Ah, you do understand. <snort> My words were not lost on your ears, skyborne. Mangletooth may be caged, but no cage can stop Agamaggan's power! <snort>

The touch of the shard, the feel of it... it has been a long time, skyborne.

Do you know what it is like? To have your power severed from you?

But, that is a tale for another time. I promised you information. I promised you Agamaggan's power. My people turned their backs on Mangletooth. Now, I lose you upon them. <snort>

objectives.text: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.$B$BCollect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>

complete.text: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!

progress.text:
No good lazy...

 Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!

accept.text: The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.$B$BI need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.

objectives.text: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.

accept.text: Tauren take pride as the protectors of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.$B$BThe Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.$B$BI need you to cull the harpies, $n!

complete.text: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!

objectives.text: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

accept.text: Limiting the number of Bloodfury Harpies will not be enough. The only true cure for their disease would be to slay their leader, Bloodfury Ripper!$B$BShe is all but a queen to those filthy creatures. Slay her and their numbers will surely diminish.$B$BGo back into the Charred Vale and you will find her along the western hills. She will not be easy to vanquish, but the reward will be great.

objectives.text: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

accept.text: Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.$B$BBesseleth and her eight-legged children of the forest have claimed this canyon as their webbed lair.$B$BMaggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat has placed a bounty on Besseleth. Slay her and bring proof of your killing to Maggran; there you will receive your reward for disposing this eight-legged menace.

objectives.text: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

accept.text: Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.$B$B$n, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.$B$BOnce you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.

objectives.text: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

accept.text: The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.$B$B$n, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

progress.text: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, $N?  Did you find my pick?

accept.text: Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $n?$B$BSoutheast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave.  I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.$B$BGo young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.

objectives.text: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

accept.text: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, $n. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.

objectives.text: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

accept.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."

complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.

objectives.text: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.

accept.text:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.

complete.text:
Ah, you have brought sunstones that the harpies collect! The harpies love to gather objects that are shiny, but they do not know the true value of the stones. By capturing the dazzling light of the sun, these stones reflect its majesty and allow us to adorn our shrines and homes with tiny motes of light in its honor. The moon, too, illuminates them with its silver beauty at night.

These stones remind us of the connection we have to the lights of the skies.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Glittering Sunstones to Mor'rogal.

progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.

complete.text: Well done, $N. But I fear the source of the poison may lie somewhere else...
What is all this?

progress.text: Did you find anything?

accept.text:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.

objectives.text: Slay quilboars and collect $1oa of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.

accept.text:
Lok-tar, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, go learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

objectives.text: Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>

complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

objectives.text: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.

progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

complete.text: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.

progress.text: Have you done what I asked?

accept.text:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!

complete.text: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.

objectives.text: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.

progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?

accept.text:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!

objectives.text: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.

progress.text: Something need doing?

complete.text: Thank you, $N. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.

progress.text:
The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.

Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.

Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.

complete.text:
You have done a great deed for our tribe today.

Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.

I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.

progress.text: Have you found our loa idols, $N? We must begin our rituals again soon.

accept.text:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!

objectives.text: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.

accept.text:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.

complete.text: Thank you for returning these weapons, $N. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.

progress.text:
Throm'ka, $c. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!

Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?

complete.text:
Ah, thank you, $N.

It means much to me to have you venture all the way out there for what must seem a trivial notion from an old tauren, but with your kindness I will have enough pigment for the rest of the season.

Thank you for supporting my livelihood, and I will strive to create something magnificent with the pigments you have brought.

progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.

complete.text:
Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.

Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.

This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.

We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.

progress.text: Did you find her?

complete.text:
Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?

Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising $c, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.
